It’s true that the meeting could yet be an icebreaker and the start of a permanent new dialogue. It’s also true that each leader can return home with something from the 90 minutes they spent together. Despite falling asleep during the main Apec summit, Donald Trump had a chance to show his proximity to two authoritarian leaders he admires. With Ukraine having destroyed Russia’s bridge into Crimea , the US president greeted Putin as not just a friend but almost a wartime ally. The Russian president, although occasionally pushed to one side by protocol during the early photo opportunities, will be able to show back home that it is Moscow, and not his adversary Europe, let alone Ukraine, that commands the respect and attention of Trump and Xi Jinping . As such, the summit was a free gift to Putin, and underlined that Trump was no longer the leader of the free world, as the former British foreign secretary Jeremy Hunt commented. From Putin’s perspective, a meeting in Berlin of the coalition of the willing was a sideshow. Europe’s attempts to isolate Russia had failed and the Asia-Pacific region had become the centre of the global economy, Putin boasted. His relationship with Trump, he said, despite the difficulties, was founded on “similar civilisational values”. For Xi, it was a prestigious chance to play host and implicitly demonstrate that the era of American hegemony is over. No longer the sole arbiter in world affairs, the US, the consumer economy, must share the stage with China , the manufacturing giant, and Russia, the energy bank. clusters.text: The Senate has passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Bill that aims to speed up the approval process for large-scale energy projects, including new power plants, grid upgrades, and data centers. Senators voted 62-33 for the bill, with the majority of Republican Senators supporting the bill and getting joined by 14 Democrat Senators and one independent. The bill is now headed for the House. The new Democratic majority will not take office until January 2027, but those Democrats in the Senate who voted against it feared it would mean weaker environmental regulation, according to Reuters. “Tonight, the passage of permitting reform in the Senate finally became reality, and we took a major step towards addressing the affordability concerns of the American people,” Senator Shelley Moore Capito, co-author of the bill, said following the vote. The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Bill got broad support from the Senate before the midterms, but voting on it was scheduled for after the elections. It was meant to speed up permitting for new energy projects, including both oil, gas, and coal projects, and alternative energy installations such as wind and solar. Many Democrats in Congress worry about the bill affecting earlier environmental regulations and weakening net-zero stipulations in earlier legislation. “Embedded in this bill is a fundamental question about the direction we go regarding our responsibilities to this planet,” Senator Jeff Merkley of Oregon commented ahead of the vote, as quoted by CBS News. Merkley acknowledged that the bill could, in fact, “turn the faucet potentially on” for wind and solar projects but suspected the Trump administration would just block these in favor of hydrocarbons. Given that President Trump has already dismantled as much of pro-transition legislation as he could, these fears may be a bit surplus at this time. clusters.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is estimated to have become the biggest entertainment launch in history following the blockbuster video game's debut on Thursday , after a 13-year wait. The highly anticipated open-world action-adventure saw pre-orders and first day sales total more than 24.5 million units, raking in about $2.36bn (£1.8bn), according to analytics platform Sensor Tower. In comparison, this year's highest grossing movie so far, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, made $2.5bn over its entire run in cinemas . GTA 6's maker Rockstar and parent company Take-Two have not released details of the game's sales but said demand has been "unprecedented". The BBC has contacted both the firms for comment. The game is the latest instalment in Rockstar's nearly three decade old crime simulator franchise, which has become one of the most popular games in history . At its core, the series is a satirical take on the American dream, putting players in the shoes of career criminals in Leonida, the game's Florida-inspired state. The latest release follows new characters Lucia and her partner Jason, a pair of small-time criminals. GTA 6 is estimated to have cost more than $1bn to develop , which would make it the most expensive video game in history. Sensor Tower said GTA 6 will be so popular that it will reduce the time gamers spend on other single-player titles by 10%. The research firm said its estimates are based on email receipts data and other statistical sources that track millions of people daily. They also track public profiles across major gaming platforms like PlayStation and Xbox, where GTA 6 is available. With just the formalities pending, Kusal Mendis turned to Prabath Jayasuriya and Jamal flaunted his range with a reverse-sweep. clusters.text: Haridwar: An elderly man from Bihar, who had gone missing at Prayagraj Kumbh Mela two years ago, has finally reunited with his loved ones. During a verification drive, he was found begging at the Kaliyar Sharif complex, which eventually helped officials trace his family.After speaking to him, a joint team of the Anti-Human Trafficking Unit (AHTU) and Kaliyar Police contacted his family. clusters.text: For professionals and businesses who follow tax, GST and corporate law through the week. For readers who mainly want TaxGuru without ads, plus the judgments and orders. Summary : The GST Appellate Tribunal, Prayagraj, dismissed Raj Trading Co.’s appeal on merits while modifying the amounts payable under the order passed on remand. The dispute concerned undeclared sales of iron and steel goods from September 2017 to March 2018. The First Appellate Authority had confirmed tax of ₹45,36,330, interest of ₹70,78,166 and a penalty of ₹45,36,330. The Tribunal sustained the finding of suppression under Section 74 but capped tax and penalty at ₹45,00,000 each, with a corresponding limit on interest up to 10 September 2024. On 23 March 2018, the Special Investigation Branch surveyed the trader’s godown-cum-office in Prayagraj and drew a Panchnama in the presence of the proprietor and two independent witnesses. A vehicle was unloading iron goods and retail sales were in progress. The Panchnama recorded that no stock register was maintained and no tax invoice had been issued for that day’s transactions. The proprietor described the use of duplicate-copy “Natraj” pads, with the original given to the customer and the counterpart destroyed after use. The officers seized stock and four sets of records marked Sanket-01 to Sanket-04. Sanket-02 comprised three bound notebooks containing 46 written pages of dated sales entries totalling ₹2,52,01,836. After a notice in Form GST DRC-01 and three reminders went unanswered, the Deputy Commissioner passed an ex parte order on 31 December 2021, estimating undeclared sales at ₹7 crore and confirming a total demand of ₹3,70,98,286. The first appellate order of 10 September 2024 reduced the estimated turnover to ₹2.50 crore and fixed tax and penalty at ₹45 lakh each and interest at ₹56.70 lakh. In Writ Tax No. 2489 of 2024, the Allahabad High Court set that order aside on 2 September 2025 because the authority had fixed undeclared sales above the figure for undeclared purchases without explaining its calculation. The High Court directed a fresh reasoned order after hearing the stakeholders. On remand, the First Appellate Authority accepted the trader’s reconciliation for three exhibits and confined the demand to the Sanket-02 entries, applying 18% GST. clusters.title: Ranchi SP (traffic) inaugurates modern traffic booth at Karamtoli Chowk to enhance road safety
clusters.text: Ranchi: Superintendent of police (traffic) Rakesh Singh inaugurated a modern traffic booth at Karamtoli Chowk on Thursday as part of a initiative to develop 20 modern traffic posts at major intersections across the state capital to streamline vehicular management and improve working conditions for on-duty personnel. Each unit is being built at an estimated cost of Rs 10 lakh.For years, traffic police personnel have operated mostly out of temporary, makeshift structures, leaving them exposed to harsh sun, heavy rain, and winter chill.The SP (traffic) said, “The department is committed to providing better amenities to our officials who remain deployed at their posts in adverse conditions for long. The modern booths offer a proper resting space, and their transparent glass panels will allow personnel to monitor traffic from inside during inclement weather.”Each smart booth is equipped with separate washrooms for male and female staff, bringing relief to nearly 600 women traffic cops.In a commuter-friendly move, the washrooms would also be accessible to women commuters, boosting civic sanitation infrastructure.Alongside upgrading roadside posts, the traffic department is preparing to expand its technological and enforcement capacity. Proposals are in place to install more than 100 new traffic signals across Ranchi—adding to the existing network of 130 lights—along with the induction of 10 new interceptor vehicles, comprising both two-wheelers and four-wheelers, to tighten road discipline.Stay updated with the latest Ranchi news.
